response.sql:
WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT major.department, COUNT(*) as dept_count
  FROM income
  JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.department
),
total_info AS (
  SELECT SUM(dept_count) as total FROM dept_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dept_counts.department,
    dept_counts.dept_count,
    1.0 * dept_counts.dept_count / total_info.total as share
  FROM dept_counts, total_info
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(above_avg.dept_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(above_avg.share) as average_share,
  AVG(above_avg.share - avg_share_value.avg_share) as average_excess
FROM with_shares as above_avg, avg_share_value
WHERE above_avg.share > avg_share_value.avg_share
